# Koala UI

> An Angular component library in the style of shadcn/ui.
> Components are copied directly into your project via the Koala CLI.

## Docs

- [Get Started](https://ui.koalarx.com/docs/get-started.md): Installation and setup
- [Patch notes](https://ui.koalarx.com/docs/patch-notes.md): CLI and scaffolding changelog

## CLI

```bash
# Install CLI
bun add -g @koalarx/ui

# Create project
kl new my-app

# Add components
kl install button,modal,dropdown

# Add AI context
kl add ai-context cursor
```
